basic_info.description: Beautiful Bungalow in prime location. Charming period details throughout! Formal entrance with enclosed porch, inviting living room with fireplace, formal dining room with built-in buffet, large eat-in kitchen, 2 spacious bedrooms (including master suite), large upstairs bonus room can be 3rd bedroom or office space. Shared rebuilt deck. Spacious lower unit 1 bed 1 bath unit with separate entrance, 2 large living areas, laundry room, bedroom, and access to large rebuilt deck. Excellent opportunity for investors or owner occupant seeking rental income. Steps from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Shopping, Dining, Transportation. Excellent opportunity for lucky buyer!
